concepts.def: February meeting of Stalin, Roosevelt and Churchill agreeing post-war division of Europe and Soviet entry to UN.
US pledge to contain communism by aiding 'free peoples'; sent $400m to Greece and Turkey.
US aid programme of $13 billion to rebuild Western Europe; Stalin forced satellites to refuse.
Stalin's closure of road and rail access to West Berlin; defeated by 11-month Anglo-American airlift.
13-day October standoff when USSR placed nuclear missiles in Cuba; Kennedy's quarantine forced Khrushchev to withdraw.
Period of relaxed tensions including SALT I (1972), Helsinki Accords (1975) and Apollo-Soyuz docking.
